caution: relative test: compare with paired_baseline. Absolute fin values inherit the ASSUMED wild-type fin baseline. No number: params are the baseline; only the direction in relative_effects is known.
label: positive
lesion: cx43-MO2 antisense morpholino (~50 nl per ray, with 5-mismatch control) injected into the first three dorsal fin rays of 3-day caudal fin regenerates and electroporated, in the fin-overgrowth mutant another long fin (alf^dty86) background. alf^dty86's own molecular lesion is explicitly stated NOT to be a cx43 gain of function.
note: alf^dty86 caudal ray segment length 609.5 vs 290.7 um wild type (2.10x); whole-fin length factor not given, so fin params are flagged increase-without-number

source.kind: measured relative effect on an assumed absolute baseline

effect_size.measured_as: WILD-TYPE REFERENCE segment length, 290.7 +/- 32.7 micrometres (not mm) in the V+3 ray of the caudal fin, versus 609.5 +/- 318.9 micrometres in alf^dty86 - about twice as long. cx43 knockdown in alf^dty86 'rescues joint formation'; the rescued segment length itself is not given as a number. cx43 transcript in alf^dty86 is 1.5-2-fold above wild type.
effect_size.statistic: mean +/- SD, n = 10 fin rays per genotype; morpholino n = 5 per treatment, 10 wild-type and 10 alf fins

lesion: sof^b123 (ZFIN ZDB-ALT-980203-591), a spontaneous allele typed by ZFIN only as SO:0001059 sequence_variant with no coding change recorded; the papers describe it as a hypomorph with 'reduced expression of cx43' / 'reduced levels of cx43 mRNA'. Sims et al. 2009 measure cx43 transcript 15-20-fold lower than wild type in sof^b123 fins.
note: short fin: ray segment and whole-fin length 50% of wild type (as recorded)

source.kind: measured relative effect on an assumed absolute baseline

note: ray segment / fin ray length 95% of wild type

caution: relative test: compare with paired_baseline. Absolute fin values inherit the ASSUMED wild-type fin baseline. No number: params are the baseline; only the direction in relative_effects is known.
label: positive
lesion: longfin^t2 (lof^t2) is an inversion on chromosome 2 with breakpoints between 5' prrx1a and 5' kcnh2a that does NOT alter the coding region of either gene; the inversion juxtaposes the prrx1a regulatory region upstream of the kcnh2a transcription start site, and the kcnh2a-side breakpoint lies within a DNA transposon not present between kcc4a and kcnh2a in the reference genome. The functional consequence reported is upregulation of kcnh2a in fins. No specific enhancer sequence or named motif is identified.
note: longfin (lof^dt2): all fins long; numbers only in figures

source.kind: measured relative effect on an assumed absolute baseline

effect_size.measured_as: pectoral fin length and caudal fin length, normalized to fish standard length, reported as fold change relative to lof/+ in figure panels; kcnh2a transcript measured by qRT-PCR normalized to gapdh (caudal fin) or beta-actin (pectoral and dorsal fin) with 2^-(ddCt). No numeric value appears in the fetched text.
effect_size.statistic: midline represents mean; error bars represent +/-1 SEM
